checked_claims.note: Verified independently. By H3, I_k=I×_B B_k ≅ P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) is a Zariski-locally trivial P^{k−1}-bundle over the reduced stratum, hence flat, open and surjective with irreducible fibres; the preimage of an irreducible component Y of B_k is irreducible, these preimages are exactly the irreducible components of I_k, and dim P^n_Y = dim Y + n for any irreducible Noetherian Y. So components of I_3 have dimension dim(image component of B_3)+2 and components of I_4 have dimension dim(image component of B_4)+3, and 'its image base component' is well defined. Reducedness is immaterial to the dimension count (the bundle over a reduced base is reduced in any case). Decisively, this claim is indexed by components of B_k, not by components of B, which is exactly what makes it immune to the base-generality defect recorded against CLM-0074-2; I checked the DVR configuration used there and C1 holds in it (0+2=2 and 0+3=3).

The clause 'every irreducible component of I over X∩B_3 has dimension d+2' requires dim(X∩B_3)=dim X=d, and 'dim X_4=d−c' requires dim+codim=dim X. Both are theorems of finite-type dimension theory over a field; neither follows from H1 as quoted, which assumes only that B is a locally Noetherian scheme over a characteristic-zero field. The asserted equality fails and the headline conclusion inverts: the h^0=4 jump does produce a strictly larger source component. Note the missing hypothesis bites exactly in the only case where C2 has content (X meeting both strata); when X⊆B_3 the clause is trivially fine. This is unresolved rather than failed only because realizability of the counter-model needs B_4≠∅, which is GAP-H0-1 / FND-0104 and is explicitly left open by this very artifact — so I can exhibit a proof gap but not an instantiated falsehood. finding_candidates.statement: Component-dimension comparisons across the h^0 jump are not valid over the base generality inherited from C66-GEO-H0. Over a base that is only locally Noetherian over a characteristic-zero field, a nonempty open subset of an irreducible component can have strictly smaller dimension than the component (Spec of a DVR containing Q: the generic point is open of dimension 0 in a 1-dimensional space), and dim Z + codim(Z,X) = dim X can fail. Consequently the step 'X is an irreducible component of the reduced base of dimension d meeting B_3, therefore the incidence over X∩B_3 has dimension d+2' is unjustified, and in the DVR configuration with the closed point in B_4 and the generic point in B_3 it is false: the incidence over X∩B_3 is P^2 over the fraction field of dimension 2 while the incidence over X_4 is P^3 over the residue field of dimension 3, so the jump stratum carries the strictly larger source component and the intended inequality inverts. The pathology needs X to meet both strata, i.e. exactly the case where the comparison has content, and realizability additionally needs B_4 ≠ ∅ (open as GAP-H0-1 / FND-0104), so this is a gap rather than an instantiated refutation. Any node comparing source-component dimensions across the jump must add 'of finite type over the field' (or an explicit biequidimensionality/catenary hypothesis), or state the comparison relative to dim(X∩B_3) rather than dim X. Statements indexed by components of the strata B_k themselves, rather than of B, are unaffected and remain valid over any locally Noetherian base.

strongest_attack: The strongest attack lands on C2, and it is the only one that lands. C2's dimension bookkeeping is written in finite-type idiom but hypothesized over ATT-0066's base generality, 'locally Noetherian scheme over a characteristic-zero field'. The clause 'every irreducible component of I over X∩B_3 has dimension d+2' needs dim(X∩B_3)=dim X, and 'dim X_4=d−c' needs dim+codim=dim X; over a general Noetherian base both fail. Counter-model permitted by H1–H4 as stated: B=Spec R with R a DVR containing Q, closed point in B_4, generic point in B_3. Then X=B is irreducible reduced with d=1, meets B_3, and X_4 is the closed point of pure codimension c=1; by H3 the source over X∩B_3 is P^2 over Frac(R) of dimension 2 (not d+2=3) while the source over X_4 is P^3 over the residue field of dimension 3, so the headline conclusion inverts — the h^0=4 jump does produce a strictly larger source component. The missing hypothesis bites precisely in the only case where C2 has content. The attack falls short of a refutation only because realizing it needs B_4≠∅, i.e. a balanced non-primitive hyperelliptic tetragonal fibre, which is GAP-H0-1/FND-0104 and is explicitly left open by this artifact; hence 'unresolved', not 'failed'. C1 is immune because it is indexed by components of B_k rather than of B, which localizes the defect exactly at the substitution of dim X for dim(X∩B_3); one clause repairs it ('of finite type over the field', or restating C2 with dim(X∩B_3)). Attacks attempted that did not land: (i) conditional-to-unconditional upgrade — the h^0∈{3,4} dichotomy is conditional in ATT-0066 on the weak CE normalization, but ATT-0074 imports it inside an explicit 'Assume (H1)–(H4)' clause and repeats the conditionality, so nothing is silently promoted; (ii) the FND-0067/FND-0101 non-closedness overclaim that sank the predecessor — C6 now proves only openness plus a witness-conditional non-closedness clause and never converts source openness into image closedness, and its jet computation (dim of the 1-jet target is 2, so ker ≥ k−2 ≥ 1, Δ_b closed by properness) is correct; (iii) C7 numerology — the excess is presentation-relative and, as shown in the finding candidate, informationally equivalent to the assumed dim B=15, but C7 asserts only arithmetic plus an explicit 'consistency check only' disclaimer, so it is true as written; (iv) C4's meta-claim 'refuted as an unconditional theorem from the H0 stratification alone' survives, since H1–H4 constrain dim B not at all (B=Spec k of one balanced curve is a model with dim B=0); (v) the standard checklist items have no purchase because none is used: no Gysin or Künneth shift, no Poincaré duality or Tate twist, no degeneration or spectral-sequence differential, no invariants-versus-coinvariants passage, no semisimplification, no integral-versus-rational coefficient step, no predicted motive, and no stable-pair or boundary-stratum analysis enters C1–C7 — the artifact's exclusion list disclaims all Hodge/Tate content and RED-0001, and it does not touch the target dictionary (which I checked for internal consistency independently: 2·21−26=16, Q(−13)(21)=Q(8) of weight −16, 26=2·13). theorem_statement: Theorem (stratified source-component test of proposed residual decompositions). Assume the hypotheses and conclusions (H1)–(H4) of ATT-0066, dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116: B is a locally Noetherian scheme over a characteristic-zero field carrying a fibrewise balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl family of genus-6 curves; L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}; the reduced strata B_3={h^0(L)=3} (open) and B_4={h^0(L)=4} (closed) exhaust the underlying space of B; B_4 is contained in the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus; I=Hilb^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6(C/B)}B is the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence; I_k:=I×_B B_k ≅ P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) is a P^{k−1}-bundle over the reduced stratum B_k; and on Conf_6 the ordered pullback tilde I equals Z_ev scheme-theoretically. Write I^dist for the distinct-support open of I and tilde I_k for the Conf_6 pullback of I_k. Then: (C1) Pure relative source dimensions. Every irreducible component of the reduced scheme I_3 has dimension equal to dim(of its image base component in B_3)+2. Every irreducible component of the reduced scheme I_4 has dimension equal to dim(of its image base component in B_4)+3. (C2) Jump-stratum comparison. Let X be an irreducible component of the reduced base of dimension d that meets B_3, and let X_4:=X∩B_4 have pure codimension c≥1 in X if nonempty. Then every irreducible component of I over X∩B_3 has dimension d+2, while every irreducible component of I over X_4 has dimension d−c+3=(d+2)+(1−c)≤d+2, with equality if and only if c=1. Thus the h^0=4 jump never produces a strictly larger source component than the h^0=3 incidence over any such X. (C3) Jump components are hyperelliptic non-primitive. Every irreducible component of I_4 is supported over the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus of B. (C4) Numerical test of the proposed 15+2=17 / pure-codimension-4 decomposition. The candidate arithmetic dim B=15 with fibre dimension 2 giving source dimension 17 and ambient codimension 21−17=4 (equivalently 19−dim B when the fibre dimension is 2) is compatible with the stratified source geometry of (C1)–(C2) if and only if the relevant base component lies in B_3 and has dimension 15. Even the coarse count b−3=15 requires a simple-branching hypothesis equating ramification degree with branch-point count, and separately a stabilizer/stack analysis to promote coarse Hurwitz dimension to a component of B. The arithmetic is not a proof of base dimension 15, generic finiteness into M_{6,6}, image purity, absence of larger special or unbalanced components, or reduced-support density. Consequently the proposed pure-codimension-4 dominant-component package survives only as a conditional source-dimension formula on B_3-components of dimension 15, and is refuted as an unconditional theorem from the H0 stratification alone. (C5) Ordered reduced fibres. Each geometric fibre of tilde I_k→B_k is either empty or equidimensional of dimension k−1; nonemptiness is not implied by χ(L)=1. (C6) Openness of reduced-support and obstruction to an automatic closed pure-codimension-4 model. The distinct-support locus I^dist is open in I (complement of the closed multiple-support image). On every geometric fibre b∈B_k, for every point p of C_b the 1-jet evaluation H^0(L_b)→(L_b)_p/m_p^2 has kernel of dimension at least k−2≥1, so the nonreduced locus Δ_b⊂|L_b| is closed and nonempty. If moreover a reduced member of |L_b| exists, then I^dist∩|L_b| is a nonempty proper open in the irreducible space |L_b|≅P^{k−1}, hence not closed in that fibre. Nonemptiness of reduced members on every fibre is not claimed. Unconditionally, I^dist is an open piece of the residual incidence; by FND-0052 it cannot be identified with a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} without a separate image-closure and special-locus analysis. Openness of the source does not control closedness of the image under the classifying map, and non-closedness of I^dist in I is not asserted without a reduced-member witness. (C7) Determinantal excess fingerprint. For ranks k,k−1 the expected determinantal codimension of {rk φ≤k−3} is 3·2=6. Matching this against the candidate ambient codimension 4 on a B_3-component of dimension 15 yields numerical excess 2, which equals h^1(L)=h^0(L)−χ(L)=3−1=2 on B_3. This is a consistency check of the candidate fingerprint only: excess alone does not prove local complete intersection, regularity, purity, or Gysin applicability. No claim is made about dim B, stabilizers, stack-level full faithfulness into M_{6,6}, image purity or codimension, emptiness of B_4, reduced-support nonemptiness on every fibre, unbalanced CE components, bielliptic/plane-quintic/trigonal special-curve components, local lci/conormal structure, or any Hodge/Tate conclusion or RED-0001.
